hook.convey: equal groups everywhere (egg trays of 6, overs of 6 balls) → multiplication counts equal groups in one go; facts up to 10 × 10 come from equal groups, equal jumps and a nearby easy fact

use.hi: Kitchen mein ande 6-6 ki tray mein aate hain, aur Maa ne 3 tray rakhi hain. Aaj dekhenge ki bina ek-ek gine kul ande kaise nikalte hain.
use.en: In the kitchen eggs come in trays of 6, and Mum has kept 3 trays. Today we see how to find all the eggs without counting them one by one.

use.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. Bowler kitne over daale, usse kul ball guna se turant pata chalti hain.
use.en: In cricket an over has 6 balls. However many overs a bowler bowls, multiplying tells the total balls at once.

explain.convey: 3 egg trays, 6 in each → 3 equal groups of 6 → 3 × 6 = 6 + 6 + 6 = 18; first number = how many groups, second = how many in each

point.hi: Dekho, 3 tray hain aur har tray mein 6 ande. Yeh 6-6 ke 3 barabar group hain. 3 × 6 ka matlab hai 6 + 6 + 6, yaani 18 ande.
point.en: Look, there are 3 trays and 6 eggs in each tray. These are 3 equal groups of 6. 3 × 6 means 6 + 6 + 6, that is 18 eggs.

prompt.hi: Ab 2 tray aur aa gayin, aur har tray mein 6 ande hain. 5 tray mein kul kitne ande hain?
prompt.en: Now 2 more trays come, with 6 eggs in each tray. How many eggs are there in 5 trays?

explain.convey: 4 × 5 as jumps: 4 equal jumps of 5 from 0 → 5, 10, 15, 20 → 4 × 5 = 20; × is the same jump again and again, + is one join

point.hi: 0 se 5-5 ki 4 chhalaang lagao: 5, 10, 15, 20. Toh 4 × 5 = 20. Guna mein wahi chhalaang baar-baar lagti hai. 4 + 5 mein sirf ek baar jodna hota hai, woh 9 hai.
point.en: Make 4 jumps of 5 from 0: 5, 10, 15, 20. So 4 × 5 = 20. In multiplying the same jump is made again and again. 4 + 5 is adding just once, which is 9.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah 0 se 3-3 ki 6 chhalaang lagao. Kahan pahunchoge, yaani 6 × 3 kitna hai?
prompt.en: In the same way make 6 jumps of 3 from 0. Where do you land, that is, what is 6 × 3?

explain.convey: a fact next to 10: 9 × 6 → 10 × 6 = 60 is easy → 9 groups of 6 is one group of 6 fewer → 60 − 6 = 54

point.hi: 9 × 6 nikalna hai. 10 × 6 = 60 aasaan hai, yaani 6-6 ke 10 group. 9 × 6 mein 1 group kam hai, toh 60 − 6 = 54.
point.en: We want 9 × 6. 10 × 6 = 60 is easy, that is 10 groups of 6. 9 × 6 has 1 group fewer, so 60 − 6 = 54.

prompt.hi: Isi tarike se 9 × 4 nikalo. 10 × 4 = 40 se shuru karo. 9 × 4 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Find 9 × 4 the same way. Start from 10 × 4 = 40. What is 9 × 4?

problem.hi: Ek packet mein 9 biscuit hain. Aman class party ke liye 7 packet laata hai. Aman ke paas kul kitne biscuit hain?
problem.en: A packet has 9 biscuits. Aman buys 7 packets for a class party. How many biscuits does Aman have?

find.hi: Aman ke paas kul kitne biscuit hain

do.hi: Pehle dekho ki yeh barabar group hain
do.en: First see that these are equal groups

why.hi: 7 barabar group hain aur har group mein 9 biscuit hain
why.en: there are 7 equal groups with 9 biscuits in each group

do.hi: Ab paas wala aasaan fact lo
do.en: Now take the easy fact next to it

why.hi: 10 se guna aasaan hai, jaise har packet mein 10 hon
why.en: multiplying by 10 is easy, as if each packet had 10

prompt.hi: Par har packet mein 10 nahi, 9 hain, yaani har packet mein 1 kam. Toh 70 mein se 7 ghatao. Kul kitne biscuit hain?
prompt.en: But each packet has 9, not 10, so each packet has 1 fewer. So take 7 away from 70. How many biscuits in all?

answer.hi: Aman ke paas kul 63 biscuit hain

why.hi: 7 × 10 = 70 mein har packet ka 1 biscuit zyada gina tha, toh 7 ghatane par 7 × 9 = 63 aata hai
why.en: 7 × 10 = 70 counted 1 extra biscuit in each packet, so taking away 7 gives 7 × 9 = 63

prompt.hi: School trip mein 6 auto hain, aur har auto mein 4 bachche baithe hain. Kul kitne bachche hain?
prompt.en: On a school trip there are 6 autos, with 4 children sitting in each auto. How many children are there in all?

prompt.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. 9 over mein kul kitni ball hongi?
prompt.en: In cricket one over has 6 balls. How many balls are there in 9 overs?

prompt.hi: Function mein kursiyon ki 7 row hain, aur har row mein 8 kursi. Kul kitni kursi hain?
prompt.en: At a function there are 7 rows of chairs, with 8 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there in all?

ladder.why: egg trays of 6 → 3 equal groups; warm-up
teams of 6 players → 7 × 6 in a story
far transfer: 3 children + 1 teacher per auto → group size first, then 8 × 4

remediation.move: number line 0-30: 6 × 4 as 6 equal jumps of 4 → lands on 24; beside it 6 + 4 as one jump of 4 starting at 6 → lands on 10; two landings → × is repeated equal jumps, + is one join

say.hi: 6 × 4 matlab 4-4 ki 6 chhalaang, jo 24 par pahunchti hain. 6 + 4 matlab 6 se sirf ek chhalaang, jo 10 par rukti hai.
say.en: 6 × 4 means 6 jumps of 4, which reach 24. 6 + 4 means just one jump from 6, which stops at 10.

prompt.hi: Ek dabbe mein 8 pencil hain. 4 dabbon mein kul kitni pencil hain?
prompt.en: A box has 8 pencils. How many pencils are there in 4 boxes?

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak humne pahade ke facts nikale. Ab kuch khaas facts dekhenge: 0 se guna, 1 se guna, kram badalna aur double karna.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we worked out times-table facts. Next we look at some special facts: times 0, times 1, changing the order, and doubling.

hook.convey: special facts that save work: groups with nothing in them (× 0), just one group (× 1), an array turned around (order), twice the groups (double a known fact)

use.hi: Ek bowler ne 3 over daale aur kisi bhi over mein ek bhi run nahi diya. Aaj dekhenge ki aise mein guna se kul run kaise nikalte hain.
use.en: A bowler bowled 3 overs and gave away no runs in any over. Today we see how multiplying gives the total runs in a case like this.

use.hi: Kitchen mein laddoo plate mein lagaane hain: kabhi plate khaali rehti hai, kabhi sirf 1 plate hoti hai. Aaj dekhenge ki 0 aur 1 se guna karne par kya hota hai.
use.en: In the kitchen laddoos go on plates: sometimes a plate stays empty, sometimes there is only 1 plate. Today we see what happens when we multiply by 0 and by 1.

explain.convey: 8 + 0 keeps 8 (nothing added); 8 × 0 = 8 empty plates → no laddoos → 0; anything × 0 is 0

point.hi: 8 + 0 mein 8 mein kuch nahi joda, toh 8 hi raha. 8 × 0 ka matlab 8 plate, aur har plate mein 0 laddoo. 8 khaali plate mein kul 0 laddoo hain.
point.en: In 8 + 0 nothing is added to 8, so it stays 8. 8 × 0 means 8 plates with 0 laddoos on each plate. 8 empty plates hold 0 laddoos in all.

prompt.hi: 5 plate hain aur har plate khaali hai. Kya 5 × 0 = 5 hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: There are 5 plates and every plate is empty. Is 5 × 0 = 5, yes or no?

explain.convey: 1 × 7 = 1 box of 7 pencils = 7; 7 × 1 = 7 children with 1 pencil each = 7; × 1 keeps the number the same, multiplying does not always make it bigger

point.hi: 1 × 7 matlab 1 dibba, aur dibbe mein 7 pencil, toh kul 7. 7 × 1 matlab 7 bachche, har ek ke paas 1 pencil, toh bhi kul 7. 1 se guna karne par number utna hi rehta hai, bada nahi hota.
point.en: 1 × 7 means 1 box with 7 pencils in it, so 7 in all. 7 × 1 means 7 children with 1 pencil each, so again 7 in all. Multiplying by 1 keeps the number the same; it does not get bigger.

prompt.hi: 1 dibbe mein 9 crayon hain. 1 × 9 ka jawab 9 se zyada hai, kam hai, ya utna hi?
prompt.en: 1 box has 9 crayons. Is the answer to 1 × 9 more than 9, less than 9, or the same?

explain.convey: 4 × 5 = 4 groups of 5 = 20 and 5 × 4 = 5 groups of 4 = 20; an array turned around swaps rows and columns, the laddoos stay the same → order does not change the answer

point.hi: 4 × 5 matlab 5-5 ke 4 group, kul 20. 5 × 4 matlab 4-4 ke 5 group, kul phir bhi 20. Laddoo ka array ghumao toh row aur column badalte hain, laddoo nahi. Toh kram badlo, jawab wahi rehta hai.
point.en: 4 × 5 means 4 groups of 5, 20 in all. 5 × 4 means 5 groups of 4, still 20 in all. Turn an array of laddoos and the rows and columns swap, not the laddoos. So change the order and the answer stays the same.

prompt.hi: 6 × 9 = 54 hai. Kya 9 × 6 ka jawab isse alag hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: 6 × 9 = 54. Will the answer to 9 × 6 be different from this, yes or no?

explain.convey: 3 × 7 = 21 is known; 6 groups are twice 3 groups → 6 × 7 is double 3 × 7 → 21 + 21 = 42

point.hi: 3 × 7 = 21 hai. 6 group, 3 group ke dugne hain, toh 6 × 7 bhi 3 × 7 ka double hai: 21 + 21 = 42.
point.en: 3 × 7 = 21. 6 groups are twice 3 groups, so 6 × 7 is double 3 × 7: 21 + 21 = 42.

prompt.hi: 4 × 8 = 32 hai. Toh 8 × 8 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 4 × 8 = 32. So what is 8 × 8?

problem.hi: 8 × 7 kitna hota hai? Jo fact pata hai, 4 × 7 = 28, uski madad se nikalo.
problem.en: What is 8 × 7? Work it out using a fact you know, 4 × 7 = 28.

do.en: Now think of doubling the groups

why.hi: dugne group mein dugni cheezein hoti hain
why.en: twice as many groups hold twice as many things

prompt.hi: Ab 28 ka double karo. 28 + 28 kitna hai, yaani 8 × 7 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now double 28. What is 28 + 28, that is, what is 8 × 7?

why.hi: 8 group, 4 group ke dugne hain, toh 28 ka double 56 aata hai
why.en: 8 groups are double 4 groups, so double 28 gives 56

prompt.hi: Ek bowler ne 4 over daale, aur kisi bhi over mein ek bhi run nahi diya. Usne kul kitne run diye?
prompt.en: A bowler bowled 4 overs and gave away no runs in any over. How many runs were given away in all?

prompt.hi: 7 × 8 matlab 8-8 ke 7 group, aur 8 × 7 matlab 7-7 ke 8 group. {friend} ka kehna hai ki dono ke jawab alag hain. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: 7 × 8 means 7 groups of 8, and 8 × 7 means 8 groups of 7. {friend} says the two answers are different. Is that right?

prompt.hi: 8 bachchon ke paas 1-1 pencil hai, yaani 8 × 1. Kabir kehta hai ki kul 9 pencil hain, kyunki guna se number bada hota hai. Kya Kabir sahi hai?
prompt.en: 8 children have 1 pencil each, that is 8 × 1. Kabir says there are 9 pencils in all, because multiplying makes a number bigger. Is Kabir right?

ladder.why: contrast 6 + 0 with 6 × 0 → adding keeps 6, empty groups give 0
error spot 9 × 1 = 10 → one group of 9 is 9
predict 9 × 4 from 4 × 9 = 36 → order does not change the answer

remediation.move: plates story: 8 plates, nothing on any plate → how many laddoos on the plates; then 8 + 0 beside 8 × 0: adding nothing keeps 8, 8 groups of nothing hold nothing

say.hi: 8 plate hain par har plate khaali hai, toh 8 plate par ek bhi laddoo nahi. 8 + 0 alag hai: wahan 8 mein kuch nahi joda, toh 8 hi raha.
say.en: There are 8 plates but every plate is empty, so the 8 plates hold not a single laddoo. 8 + 0 is different: there nothing is added to 8, so it stays 8.

prompt.hi: 6 dibbe hain aur har dibba khaali hai. 6 dibbon mein kul kitne laddoo hain?
prompt.en: There are 6 boxes and every box is empty. How many laddoos are there in the 6 boxes?

remediation.move: array of laddoos 4 rows of 6, turned a quarter turn → 6 rows of 4; no laddoo added or taken away → both totals 24

say.hi: 4 × 6 ka array ghumao toh 6 × 4 ban jaata hai. Na koi laddoo juda, na koi hata, toh dono 24 hain.
say.en: Turn the 4 × 6 array and it becomes 6 × 4. No laddoo was added and none was taken away, so both are 24.

prompt.hi: Laddoo ka array: 3 row, har row mein 5. Ghumaya toh 5 row, har row mein 3. Kya kul laddoo badle, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: An array of laddoos: 3 rows with 5 in each row. Turned around: 5 rows with 3 in each row. Did the total number of laddoos change, yes or no?

remediation.move: one box with 7 pencils in it: how many groups (1), how many in each (7), how many in all (7) → one group of 7 cannot be more than 7

say.hi: 1 × 7 matlab 7 ka sirf 1 group. Ek dibbe mein 7 pencil hain, toh kul 7 hi hain, zyada nahi.
say.en: 1 × 7 means just 1 group of 7. One box has 7 pencils, so there are just 7 in all, not more.

prompt.hi: 1 dibbe mein 6 crayon hain. {friend} ka kehna hai ki 1 × 6 = 7. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: 1 box has 6 crayons. {friend} says 1 × 6 = 7. Is that right?

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab saare pahade ek saath guna chart mein dekhenge. Wahan har row mein ek pattern chhupa hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we see all the tables together in the multiplication chart. Every row there hides a pattern.

hook.convey: the multiplication chart is full of patterns: along a row each next fact grows by the row's number; the 5s end in 5 or 0; the 4s are double the 2s; in the 9s the tens go up and the ones go down

use.hi: Pahada ek gaana jaisa hai: 5, 10, 15, 20, har baar wahi taal. Aaj guna chart mein aisi hi music jaisi taal dhoondhenge.
use.en: A times table is like a song: 5, 10, 15, 20, the same beat every time. Today we find beats like this music in the multiplication chart.

use.hi: Guna chart ek game jaisa hai: pattern pakdo toh agla number bina guna kiye bata sakte ho.
use.en: The multiplication chart is like a game: catch the pattern and you can tell the next number without multiplying.

explain.convey: in the 5 row: 5 × 4 = 20 → the next fact 5 × 5 is 20 + 5 = 25, not 20 + 1; along a row each next fact grows by the row's own number

point.hi: 5 ke pahade mein 5 × 4 = 20 hai. Agla fact 5 × 5 hai, toh 1 nahi, 5 aur jodo: 20 + 5 = 25. Pahade mein agla number utna badhta hai jitne ka pahada hai.
point.en: In the 5 table, 5 × 4 = 20. The next fact is 5 × 5, so add 5 more, not 1: 20 + 5 = 25. In a table the next number grows by the table's own number.

prompt.hi: 5 × 8 = 40 hai. Isse socho, 5 × 9 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 5 × 8 = 40. Using this, what is 5 × 9?

explain.convey: the 5 table 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40 → last digit goes 5, 0, 5, 0; 5 × an odd number ends in 5, 5 × an even number ends in 0

point.hi: 5 ka pahada dekho: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40. Aakhri ank baari-baari se 5, 0, 5, 0 aata hai. 5 ko odd number se guna karo toh aakhri ank 5, even number se karo toh 0.
point.en: Look at the 5 table: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40. The last digit goes 5, 0, 5, 0 in turn. Multiply 5 by an odd number and the last digit is 5; by an even number and it is 0.

prompt.hi: Bina guna kiye batao: kya 5 × 7 ka jawab 0 par khatam hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Without multiplying, tell me: will the answer to 5 × 7 end in 0, yes or no?

explain.convey: the 2 table 2, 4, 6, 8 beside the 4 table 4, 8, 12, 16 → every number in the 4 table is double the 2 table's number in the same place

point.hi: 2 ka pahada: 2, 4, 6, 8. 4 ka pahada: 4, 8, 12, 16. 4 ke pahade ka har number, 2 ke pahade ke number ka double hai.
point.en: The 2 table: 2, 4, 6, 8. The 4 table: 4, 8, 12, 16. Every number in the 4 table is double the number in the 2 table.

prompt.hi: 2 × 9 = 18 hai. Toh 4 × 9 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 2 × 9 = 18. So what is 4 × 9?

problem.hi: 9 ka pahada: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45. Yeh 9 × 1 se 9 × 5 tak hain. Ankon ka pattern dhoondho aur bina guna kiye 9 × 6 likho.
problem.en: The 9 table: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45. These are 9 × 1 to 9 × 5. Find the pattern in the digits and write 9 × 6 without multiplying.

do.en: First look at the tens digits: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4

steps.result: dahai ka ank har baar 1 badhta hai

why.hi: 9 jodna matlab 10 jodna aur 1 ghatana, toh dahai 1 badhti hai
why.en: adding 9 is adding 10 and taking 1 away, so the tens go up by 1

do.en: Now look at the ones digits: 9, 8, 7, 6, 5

steps.result: ikai ka ank har baar 1 ghatta hai

why.hi: har baar wahi 1 ghataya jaata hai
why.en: that same 1 is taken away each time

prompt.hi: Ab 45 ke baad dahai 1 badhao aur ikai 1 ghatao. 9 × 6 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now after 45, raise the tens by 1 and lower the ones by 1. What is 9 × 6?

why.hi: 45 ki dahai 4 se 5 hui aur ikai 5 se 4 hui, aur 45 + 9 = 54 bhi yahi batata hai
why.en: the tens of 45 went from 4 to 5 and the ones from 5 to 4, and 45 + 9 = 54 says the same

prompt.hi: 4 ke pahade mein 4 × 6 = 24 hai. Agla fact 4 × 7 hai. 4 × 7 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: In the 4 table, 4 × 6 = 24. The next fact is 4 × 7. What is 4 × 7?

prompt.hi: Guna chart ki 3 wali row: 3, 6, 9, 12. 12 ke baad agla number kya hai?
prompt.en: The 3 row of the multiplication chart: 3, 6, 9, 12. What is the next number after 12?

prompt.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. 7 over mein 42 ball hui. 8 over mein kitni ball hongi?
prompt.en: In cricket one over has 6 balls. 7 overs had 42 balls. How many balls are there in 8 overs?

ladder.why: predict whether 5 × 9 ends in 0 or 5 → the 5s pattern

remediation.move: dot array: 5 rows of 8 = 40 → one more dot added to every one of the 5 rows → 5 new dots → 40 + 5 = 45 = 5 × 9; the next fact in the 5 table is +5, in the 7 table +7

say.hi: 5 × 8 mein 8-8 ki 5 row hain, kul 40. Har row mein 1 bindu aur jodo toh 5 naye bindu aate hain, isliye 5 × 9 = 40 + 5 = 45.
say.en: 5 × 8 is 5 rows of 8, 40 in all. Add 1 more dot to every row and 5 new dots come in, so 5 × 9 = 40 + 5 = 45.

prompt.hi: 3 × 6 = 18 hai. Toh 3 × 7 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 3 × 6 = 18. So what is 3 × 7?
